title: Tuvio's Time Potions
description: Fast-forward your mob growth in a vanilla-friendly way, or make them cute little babies forever.
body:
This mod adds, at the time of writing this, two potions:
- Rejuvenation potion, brewed from a potato and plain water bottles. Will make your animals babies for 999999999 (!) in-game ticks, or 11574,0740625~ real-time days. That's a lot of days.

- Aging potion, brewed from a bamboo and plain water bottles. Will instantly age animals.

Turn'em into splash potions, and yeet them at your friends or animals. Or drink'em. It won't do much.
